name: UTC Offset
definition: Offset of the time before or after 00:00 hour UTC.

Sign.definition: Indicates whether the offset is before or after 00:00 hour UTC.

NumberOfHours.name: Number Of Hours
NumberOfHours.definition: Offset of the reporting time, in hours,  before or after 00:00 hour UTC.

Location.name: Location
Location.definition: Location to which the time zone applies.
